Earn miles with every stay {column-start}

Miles & More members now earn valuable miles with every stay. It’s this easy: book a hotel with our hotel partner Booking.com, enjoy your stay, and have your miles credited.* You’ll earn one mile for every EUR 1 you spend. Your miles will be credited to your mileage account eight to twelve weeks after your hotel stay.

See the hotel offers

Register with Miles & More now

{column-end}

*Only for hotel bookings made via lufthansa.com and where your Miles & More service card number is provided during the booking process. Miles cannot be credited retroactively. You’ll receive your miles 8-12 weeks after your stay. {copytext-small}
